sourceChecks.text: Abijah stood up on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, “Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel:
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 「エフライムの山地」という地域名であり、民の集団を指す用例とは区別。

sourceChecks.text: When Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the hill country of Ephraim; and he renewed the LORD’s altar that was before the LORD’s porch.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: He gathered all Judah and Benjamin, and those who lived with them out of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Simeon; for they came to him out of Israel in abundance when they saw that the LORD his God was with him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エフライムから移り住んだ人々を指す集団用例。

sourceChecks.text: He placed forces in all the fortified cities of Judah, and set garrisons in the land of Judah and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エフライムの町々という地域記述。

sourceChecks.text: Jehoshaphat lived at Jerusalem; and he went out again among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim, and brought them back to the LORD, the God of their fathers.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エフライム山地という地域記述。

sourceChecks.text: A man of God came to him, saying, “O king, don’t let the army of Israel go with you, for the LORD is not with Israel, with all the children of Ephraim.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 子ら（人々）として呼ばれる集団用例。

sourceChecks.text: Then Amaziah separated them, the army that had come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again. Therefore their anger was greatly kindled against Judah, and they returned home in fierce anger.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エフライムから来た兵士たちを指す集団用例。

sourceChecks.text: Joash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah, the son of Joash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth Shemesh and brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maaseiah the king’s son, Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エフライム出身の勇士を示す所属用例。

sourceChecks.text: Then some of the heads of the children of Ephraim, Azariah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against those who came from the war,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エフライムの指導者たちを指す集団用例。

sourceChecks.text: Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the LORD’s house at Jerusalem, to keep the Passover to the LORD, the God of Israel.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 招きの手紙の宛先となる民の集団名。

sourceChecks.text: So the couriers passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun, but people ridiculed them and mocked them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エフライムの国を通るという地理的用例。

sourceChecks.text: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet they ate the Passover other than the way it is written. For Hezekiah had prayed for them, saying, “May the good LORD pardon everyone
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 過越祭に来たエフライムの人々を指す。

sourceChecks.text: Now when all this was finished, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Judah and broke the pillars in pieces, cut down the Asherah poles, and broke down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, also in Ephraim and Manasseh, until they had destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エフライムの町々という地理的用例。

sourceChecks.text: He did this in the cities of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, even to Naphtali, around in their ruins.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: エフライムの町々という地理的用例。

sourceChecks.text: They came to Hilkiah the high priest and delivered the money that was brought into God’s house, which the Levites, the keepers of the threshold, had gathered from the hands of Manasseh, Ephraim, of all the remnant of Israel, of all Judah and Benjamin, and of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 神殿へ金を届けたエフライムの残りの民を指す。
